protocol_change_from_v6: Two prespecified rounds compare fresh current v5 with v7, which uses v6 presentation only for fully parsed route tasks and exact v5 presentation otherwise. Facts, tools, model, read points and per-trial wire admission budgets are shared. New independent public-receipt metrics distinguish informed post-completion calls from calls preplanned in one response. No metric, declaration or completion check gates tools. Historical results are not concurrent observations. The 24-trial scope has 200k tokens per new round and 600k across the completed v6 study plus this prespecified v7 study.
